title: Two-face bench bracket
brief: Make a prototype bracket for a small bench sensor: an 80 × 40 mm foot, 45 mm overall height and 5 mm material. Two 6.4 mm vertical bores are 50 mm apart at y=-7; two 4.5 mm horizontal bores use the same spacing, 30 mm above the foot. Leave the specified sensor envelope unobstructed. This is a fit prototype, not a rated structural mount.

parts.label: Two-face bench bracket
parts.material: Prototype plastic; process and grade not selected
parts.notes: Two gussets connect the faces. Verify fastener/tool access and printed hole fit before installation.

checks.reason: The bracket must fit the measured installation envelope.
The first base mounting hole must match the bench pattern.
The second base hole must be 50 mm from the first.
The sensor mounting hole must have the specified height and diameter.
The sensor mounting pattern requires 50 mm between centres.
The clearance reference must represent the specified sensor envelope.
Keep at least 5 mm clear around the sensor envelope.
Keep the installation-space reference fixed to the acceptance brief.
The finished bracket must stay inside the available 100 mm work envelope.
Preserve the specified 10 mm diameter fastener/tool access above the left foot hole.
Preserve the specified fastener/tool access above the right foot hole.
Preserve the specified 10 mm diameter access in front of the left sensor hole.
Preserve the specified fastener/tool access in front of the right sensor hole.
The gusset must not obstruct access to the left foot fastener.
The gusset must not obstruct access to the right foot fastener.
The gusset must not obstruct access to the left sensor fastener.
The gusset must not obstruct access to the right sensor fastener.

assumptions: Dimensions describe a synthetic acceptance brief, not a measured commercial sensor.
No load, fatigue, temperature or electrical-safety qualification has been performed.
Nominal bores must be checked against the selected process and actual fasteners.
assembly: Review the STEP and individual drawing against your measurements.
Make a fit prototype; check hole spacing, tool access and the sensor envelope.
Use only after choosing appropriate material and verifying the actual loads and mounting surfaces.
hardware: Fastener sizes and lengths require selection against the real bench and sensor; bore diameters alone do not define a safe joint.
